title: Polymarket hourly crypto 'above K' markets (BTC, ETH) vs digital fair value from Deribit DVOL
mechanism: Hourly threshold markets are 1-hour digital options; retail takers overpay 'exciting' rungs (B-24, B-21) while a deep options market (Deribit DVOL) gives an independent fair value. Payer: taker rung buyers. Cost: taker fee 0.07*p*(1-p) (B-03).
expression: at T-60min for each hourly BTC/ETH 'above K' market: p* = N(d2) with Hyperliquid spot and the latest hourly DVOL scaled to the remaining horizon; buy the side whose ask < p* by at least the taker fee 0.07*p*(1-p); hold to settlement; P&L per dollar net of fees

power.effect_source: justdance trading P&L net of fees, Mar-Sep 2026 (L-29), survivor proxy
power.note: UNDERPOWERED in history on P&L; forward ~0.7 year; BTC and ETH windows are correlated

kpi_secondary: Brier of market price vs p* on resolutions; markout of (ask - p*) at +15/+45 min
data: Hugging Face SII-WANGZJ/Polymarket_data trades.parquet + markets.parquet (on-chain, read by DuckDB httpfs)
falsification: historical window = hourly markets from 2026-04-01 to the end of the on-chain dataset: REJECT unless t(net P&L per dollar) >= required_t(2 trials) with the same sign on BTC and ETH; otherwise forward t-SPRT on net P&L per window with pristine_after = shadow start
untouched: no price, return or resolution of these markets has been read; only market metadata (counts of expiries per day)

title: Short the Hyperliquid perp from D-30 to D before insider/investor cliff unlocks >= 1% of max supply (DefiLlama calendars)
mechanism: Teams and investors sell or hedge around unlocks known in advance; Keyrock (Dec 2024, 16,000+ events on 40 tokens): 90% negative, pressure often starts 30 days before, team unlocks worst (C-10). Payer: unhedged holders. Conflict of interest: Keyrock sells the hedge.
expression: for each cliff of an 'insiders' or 'privateSale' allocation >= 1% of max supply on a token listed as a Hyperliquid perp: short at the close of D-30, cover at the close of D; return relative to ETH, funding included; statistic = event return minus the same token's mean return over its non-unlock 30-day windows

power.sigma_source: 30-day log return relative to ETH, 1,043 windows, 40 tokens (C-21)
power.note: n = 108 (2025) + 94 (2026 to date) cliffs on HL perps (C-20); overlapping monthly unlocks reduce effective n

kpi_primary: mean relative excess return (event minus own baseline)
falsification: window 2025-01-01 onwards (after the Dec 2024 publication): REJECT unless the mean excess return is negative with t <= -required_t(1 trial); the calendar is not point-in-time, so the best possible historical status is CANDIDATE, confirmed only in forward on daily dated snapshots of the calendars
untouched: no event-conditional return has been computed; only the unconditional sigma and drift of the 40 tokens (C-21)
